description.value: Mui Garden is a Hong Kong-style cafe established in Vancouver since 1992, celebrated for its authentic Malaysian curry blended from over twenty spices and its world-famous Hai-Nam chicken made with both free-range and farm chickens. Originally operating in Hong Kong for over a decade before opening its first Canadian location on Victoria Drive, the restaurant has grown to four Greater Vancouver locations. The Victoria Drive spot offers full dine-in service and online ordering, making it a convenient meal stop in East Vancouver.
